title: DEL02 — Prepare an accurate research write-up and submission package
description:
Original request
Earlier user requested experiment history, conclusions and a scientific-style repository.

Current evidence / status
New results and limitations are documented internally; public publication is currently disabled by user's later instruction.

Bounded work and acceptance criteria
Build a concise model-by-model result narrative with actual personal-data contribution, unsuccessful approaches, reproducibility and immutable evidence. Verify challenge deadline/requirements when preparing submission. Obtain explicit publication/submission instruction before any new external posting.

Dependencies and exclusions
Depends on resolved results/model registry. Do not claim learning directly from phone-action labels or reliable generalization.


12 October execution plan
24-hour plan reserves final five hours for: 60–90s matched human/baseline/intervention video; explicit phone-observations→scene→expert robot actions→policy→controller diagram; subgoal result table; release timeline; four case cards including already-complete and failure. Keep project private. Draft figure layout while GPU runs; preserve negative results. Do not claim a mechanism or improvement before measurement.

12 October final OST sweep decision
Private consolidated report and model registry prepared with296newscored episodes, training identities, negative results, matched-state checks, family uncertainty, reproduction and media limitations. Results/report live at /var/tmp/typhon-ost-sweep-20261012/report. Existing publication remains private; no submission. A polished new public demonstration/URL repair is separate from the internal scientific report.

13 October planner-directed private synthesis
45-minute cap: 05:17:37–06:02:37 UTC. Update the existing consolidated REPORT.md in place, 1,400–2,000 words, with claim-to-evidence index and package-status receipt. Pin DATA07, EVAL02R and DEL01; preserve all numerical/raw artifacts and old report through Git. No training, inference, physics, new media, uploads, deployment or publication. Complete only private-review component; actual hosting/submission remains pending. Branch research/del02-private-synthesis.

13 October private-package result
Private-review component complete at artifact commit d3da433054b435a9d1e99b8dc64fe0f516666e51. Existing experiment-history/2026-10-12-ost-sweep/REPORT.md revised in place to 1,777 words; original report preserved in Git. Fourteen claim groups link 46 evidence/protocol files and 12 exact model/controller identities. Thirty-seven numerical checks and 44 relative-link checks pass. DATA07, EVAL02R and DEL01 versions pinned. Canonical DEL01 media manifest reused; no bulk copy, new video, inference, physics, training, upload, deployment or publication.

Kept in Review for package disposition and remaining submission/delivery requirements. A private-review-ready package is not a submitted application, public reproducibility or completion of the OST. Final challenge/deadline/eligibility check, current representative-media hosting/importer integration and any publication/submission remain pending. EVAL02 68 interventions unexecuted; LIVE01 and all blocked/parked experiments retained. No unsupported quantitative or novelty claims added.
